- **Session-wide**: about 200 more user, plugin and built-in skills are also loaded. I left them out to stay under 300 words and can list them if you want.

## 2. Invocation

- **Entrypoint**: `<trial-project>/.claude/skills/website-build-skill/SKILL.md`
- **How I checked**: I opened each file and read its first 3 lines. I read `prompts/00-start.md` in full.

**Asset files it names:**
- **READ**: `manifest.json`
- **READ**: `prompts/00-start.md`, `01-website-deep-research.md`, `03-extract-brand-kit.md`, `04-three-mockups.md`, `05-stack-and-build.md`, `06-site-audit.md`, `07-accessibility-contrast.md`, `08-seo-aeo.md`, `09-security-headers.md`, `10-adversarial-pre-ship.md`, `11-ship-and-verify.md`, `12-web-design-team.md`, `13-coding-research.md`

- **READ**: `templates/brief.md`, `brand.md`, `tokens.json`, `evidence.md`, `handoff.yaml`, `audit-brief.md`, `site-operations.md`, `status.md`

## 3. First job

- **Researcher** goes first.
- **Step one**: set the ASK DATE (the date the work starts). It must not come from asking you or from model knowledge. The rule and the fallback steps for finding it are in `playbooks/research-and-memory.md#ask-date-rule`. The date, which step found it and the raw evidence go in `site-work/research/library/scope.md`.
- **Must produce first**: the saved research library at `site-work/research/library/`, with a receipt for each source fetched. Its gate (research.md AD01-AD08, R01-R06, plus a `check-library` pass) must pass before any other job starts.
